_source: Told by the club on 13 September 2026: for 26/27 the club captain is Daniel McLane and the vice-captain is Andrew Allen. No third-choice captain was named. Told by the club on 6 November 2026: Luke Munns is Player of the Month for October 2026, for the matches against Peps All Stars, Juizo and TSM Rovers. The club's own award, so the TSM match of 1 November counts towards it and the citation names the three rather than claiming a calendar month.
_note: Recognition the club has decided and not entered in Control panel -> Recognition. The same device as articles-extra.json: it sits under the database, so a record entered in the panel with the same id, or a leadership record for the same season, wins and this one drops out of the build. A leadership record is a fact about a SEASON, so 25/26's (Jim El Bayati, Daniel McLane, Andrew Allen) stays in the site's own baseline and keeps its place on the 25/26 tabs; every page that shows today's armband reads the latest season's record.

recognition.note: Daniel McLane is club captain for 26/27, with Andrew Allen as vice-captain.

recognition.reason:
Congratulations to Luke on being named Sue’s Angels FC Player of the Month for October.

Three matches, two clean sheets and nine saves. Two in the 4-0 at Peps All Stars, four at Juizo, where he kept out a side from four divisions above us for the full 90, and three more in the 6-1 against TSM Rovers.

The Juizo tie was lost on penalties, which is not something anybody puts on a goalkeeper. The clean sheet was still his. The only goal he conceded across the three was an outstanding TSM free-kick.

Congratulations, Luke.
